name: main

env:
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  PYTHONFORANDROID_PREREQUISITES_INSTALL_INTERACTIVE: 0
  APP_ANDROID_ACCEPT_SDK_LICENSE: "1"
  ANDROID_SDK_ROOT: /home/runner/.buildozer/android/platform/android-sdk
  ANDROID_HOME: /home/runner/.buildozer/android/platform/android-sdk
  PIP_USE_PEP517: "0"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build_unsigned:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Download ZIP from Release
        run: |
          set -e
          TAG=v0.7.2.1
          REPO="$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          rm -rf app extracted release.zip
          echo "TAG=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$REPO"
          if gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$REPO" -p "*.zip" --clobber; then
            ZIP=$(ls -1 *.zip | head -1)
            mv "$ZIP" release.zip
          else
            gh api "repos/$REPO/zipball/$TAG" > release.zip
          fi
          mkdir -p extracted
          unzip -q release.zip -d extracted
          PROJECT_DIR=$(find extracted -type f -name "main.py" -exec dirname {} \; | head -1)
          if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
            PROJECT_DIR=$(find extracted -type f -name "__main__.py" -exec dirname {} \; | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
            find extracted -maxdepth 5
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -d "$PROJECT_DIR/imprisonment" ]; then
            PROJECT_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/imprisonment"
          fi
          mkdir -p app
          cp -r "$PROJECT_DIR"/. app/
          if [ ! -f app/main.py ] && [ -f app/__main__.py ]; then
            cp app/__main__.py app/main.py
          fi
          rm -f app/setup.py app/pyproject.toml app/_game_main.py
          test -f app/main.py
          test -f app/buildozer.spec

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Cache NDK/SDK
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: /home/runner/.buildozer
          key: buildozer-ndk25b-sdk34-v3

      - name: Setup Environment
        run: |
          set -e
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y git zip unzip wget python3-pip python3-venv autoconf automake libltdl-dev libtool pkg-config zlib1g-dev libncurses5-dev libncursesw5-dev libtinfo5 cmake libffi-dev libssl-dev build-essential gettext
          pip3 install --user --upgrade buildozer "cython==0.29.36" "setuptools==59.8.0"
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          SDK="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          mkdir -p "$SDK/cmdline-tools" "$SDK/licenses" "$HOME/.android"
          touch "$HOME/.android/repositories.cfg"
          if [ ! -x "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then
            curl -fsSL -o /tmp/cmdtools.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip
            unzip -q /tmp/cmdtools.zip -d /tmp/cmdtools
            rm -rf "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest"
            mv /tmp/cmdtools/cmdline-tools "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest"
          fi
          echo "24333f8a63b6825ea9c5514f07c3498d" > "$SDK/licenses/android-sdk-license"
          echo "84831b9409646161cbf74d67cb9a794" > "$SDK/licenses/android-sdk-preview-license"
          yes | "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --sdk_root="$SDK" --licenses >/dev/null || true
          "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --sdk_root="$SDK" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
          mkdir -p "$SDK/tools/bin"
          ln -sf "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "$SDK/tools/bin/sdkmanager"

      - name: Add local p4a recipes
        run: |
          python3 << 'ENDPY'
          import textwrap
          from pathlib import Path
          Path("app/p4a-recipes/pygame-ce").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          Path("extract.py").write_text(textwrap.dedent(r'''
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path("out.txt")
          lines = p.read_text(errors="ignore").splitlines() if p.exists() else []
          skip = ("grpmodule", "Wimplicit", "print-multi-os", "CMake", "GITHUB_", "export ")
          keys = ("FOUND HEADER", "REWROTE pyproject", "PATCHED setup.py", "ENSURE HOST", "HOST CYTHON", "HOST PIP", "CYTHON ", "BUILD_EXT", "BUILD LIBS", "COPIED ", "You need cython", "BUILD FAILURE", "No main.py", "Copying main.py", "full private data", "Command failed", "available in the bin", "PREPENDED", "gradlew", "FAILURE:")
          print("=== KEY ===")
          n = 0
          for l in lines:
              if any(s in l for s in skip):
                  continue
              if l.startswith("# ") and " = " in l:
                  continue
              if any(k in l for k in keys):
                  print(l[:400]); n += 1
                  if n >= 50:
                      break
          print("=== TAIL ===")
          useful = [l for l in lines if not (l.startswith("export ") or (l.startswith("# ") and " = " in l) or any(s in l for s in skip))]
          for l in useful[-50:]:
              print(l[:400])
          '''))
          Path("app/p4a-recipes/pygame-ce/__init__.py").write_text(textwrap.dedent(r'''
          import glob, os, re, sh, shutil, subprocess
          from os.path import exists, join
          from pythonforandroid.logger import shprint
          from pythonforandroid.recipe import CompiledComponentsPythonRecipe
          from pythonforandroid.toolchain import current_directory
          BAD = ("Xcode", ".framework", "macOS", "iOS", "tvOS", "VisualC", "mingw", "darwin", "windows")
          class Fmt(dict):
              def __missing__(self, key):
                  print("SETUP PLACEHOLDER MISSING", key)
                  return ""
          class PygameCeRecipe(CompiledComponentsPythonRecipe):
              version = "2.5.5"
              url = "https://github.com/pygame-community/pygame-ce/archive/refs/tags/{version}.tar.gz"
              site_packages_name = "pygame"
              name = "pygame-ce"
              depends = ["sdl2", "sdl2_image", "sdl2_mixer", "sdl2_ttf", "setuptools", "jpeg", "png"]
              call_hostpython_via_targetpython = False
              install_in_hostpython = False
              def _host_bin(self):
                  cands = [getattr(self, "hostpython_location", None), getattr(self.ctx, "hostpython", None)]
                  storage = getattr(self.ctx, "storage_dir", "") or ""
                  if storage:
                      cands.extend(glob.glob(join(storage, "build", "other_builds", "hostpython3", "*", "hostpython3", "native-build", "root", "usr", "local", "bin", "python")))
                  for h in cands:
                      if h and os.path.exists(h) and os.access(h, os.X_OK):
                          return h
                  return None
              def _host_env(self):
                  env = os.environ.copy()
                  for k in ("CC", "CXX", "CFLAGS", "CXXFLAGS", "LDFLAGS", "CPPFLAGS", "AR", "LD", "ARCHFLAGS", "_PYTHON_HOST_PLATFORM", "NDK_CC", "NDK_CXX", "PYTHONHOME", "PYTHONPATH"):
                      env.pop(k, None)
                  env["PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK"] = "1"
                  env["PIP_USE_PEP517"] = "0"
                  return env
              def _host_site(self, host):
                  sites = []
                  root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(host)))
                  sites.extend(glob.glob(join(root, "lib", "python*", "site-packages")))
                  try:
                      out = subprocess.check_output([host, "-c", "import site; print('\\n'.join(site.getsitepackages()))"], env=self._host_env(), text=True)
                      for line in out.splitlines():
                          if line and line not in sites:
                              sites.append(line)
                  except Exception as e:
                      print("SITE LIST FAIL", e)
                  print("HOST SITES", sites)
                  return sites
              def _ensure_host_pkgs(self, required=False):
                  host = self._host_bin()
                  print("ENSURE HOST host=", host, "required=", required)
                  if not host:
                      if required:
                          raise RuntimeError("hostpython missing")
                      print("ENSURE HOST skip, not ready")
                      return []
                  env = self._host_env()
                  probe = subprocess.call([host, "-c", "import Cython; print(Cython.__version__)"], env=env)
                  print("CYTHON PROBE", probe)
                  if probe != 0:
                      subprocess.call([host, "-m", "ensurepip", "--upgrade"], env=env)
                      cmd = [host, "-m", "pip", "install", "setuptools==59.8.0", "wheel==0.38.4", "cython==0.29.36"]
                      print("HOST PIP", cmd)
                      subprocess.check_call(cmd, env=env)
                      subprocess.check_call([host, "-c", "import Cython; print(Cython.__version__)"], env=env)
                  print("HOST CYTHON OK")
                  return self._host_site(host)
              def _find_header(self, root, filename):
                  hits = []
                  if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
                      return hits
                  for dirpath, dirnames, files in os.walk(root):
                      dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in (".git", "test", "docs", "Xcode", "VisualC", "mingw")]
                      if filename not in files:
                          continue
                      if any(b in dirpath for b in BAD):
                          continue
                      hits.append(dirpath)
                      parent = os.path.dirname(dirpath)
                      if os.path.basename(dirpath) == "SDL2" and parent not in hits:
                          hits.append(parent)
                      print("FOUND HEADER", filename, dirpath)
                  hits.sort(key=lambda p: (0 if p.replace("\\\\", "/").endswith("/include") else 1, len(p)))
                  return hits
              def _inc(self, dirs):
                  return " ".join("-I" + d for d in dirs[:4])
              def prebuild_arch(self, arch):
                  super().prebuild_arch(arch)
                  self._cython_sites = self._ensure_host_pkgs(required=False)
                  with current_directory(self.get_build_dir(arch.arch)):
                      open("pyproject.toml", "w").write("[project]\nname = \"pygame-ce\"\nversion = \"2.5.5\"\ndescription = \"Python Game Development\"\nreadme = \"README.rst\"\nrequires-python = \">=3.9\"\n\n[build-system]\nrequires = [\"setuptools\", \"wheel\"]\nbuild-backend = \"setuptools.build_meta\"\n")
                      print("REWROTE pyproject.toml (keep version, skip meson)")
                      sp = open("setup.py").read().replace("from setuptools import setup", "from distutils.core import setup")
                      open("setup.py", "w").write(sp)
                      print("PATCHED setup.py to distutils")
                      setup_template = open(join("buildconfig", "Setup.Android.SDL2.in")).read()
                      png = self.get_recipe("png", self.ctx)
                      png_dir = png.get_build_dir(arch.arch)
                      png_lib_dir = join(png_dir, ".libs") if exists(join(png_dir, ".libs")) else png_dir
                      jpeg = self.get_recipe("jpeg", self.ctx)
                      jpeg_dir = jpeg.get_build_dir(arch.arch)
                      boot = self.ctx.bootstrap.build_dir
                      jni = join(boot, "jni")
                      libs = join(boot, "libs", arch.arch)
                      ndk_lib = getattr(arch, "ndk_lib_dir_versioned", "")
                      sdl_h = self._find_header(join(jni, "SDL"), "SDL.h") or [join(jni, "SDL", "include")]
                      ttf_h = self._find_header(jni, "SDL_ttf.h")
                      img_h = self._find_header(jni, "SDL_image.h")
                      mix_h = self._find_header(jni, "SDL_mixer.h")
                      sdl_includes = " " + self._inc(sdl_h) + " -L" + libs + " -L" + png_lib_dir + " -L" + jpeg_dir + ((" -L" + ndk_lib) if ndk_lib else "")
                      setup_file = setup_template.format_map(Fmt(sdl_includes=sdl_includes, sdl_ttf_includes=self._inc(ttf_h), sdl_image_includes=self._inc(img_h), sdl_mixer_includes=self._inc(mix_h), freetype_includes="", jpeg_includes="-I" + jpeg_dir, png_includes="-I" + png_dir))
                      setup_file = re.sub(r"src_c/simd_\S+\.c\s*", "", setup_file)
                      setup_file = re.sub(r"src_c/scale_mmx\.c\s*", "", setup_file)
                      setup_file = re.sub(r"^scrap\s+.*$", "# scrap disabled", setup_file, flags=re.M)
                      setup_file = setup_file.replace("-lharfbuzz", "").replace("-lfreetype", "")
                      open("Setup", "w").write(setup_file)
                      self._extra_cflags = " ".join([self._inc(sdl_h), self._inc(ttf_h), self._inc(img_h), self._inc(mix_h), "-I" + jpeg_dir, "-I" + png_dir, "-Wno-error", "-Wno-implicit-function-declaration"])
                      print("EXTRA CFLAGS", self._extra_cflags)
              def build_compiled_components(self, arch):
                  sites = self._ensure_host_pkgs(required=True)
                  env = self.get_recipe_env(arch)
                  if sites:
                      env["PYTHONPATH"] = ":".join(sites) + ":" + env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
                      print("CYTHON PYTHONPATH", env["PYTHONPATH"][:300])
                  host = self._host_bin()
                  r = subprocess.call([host, "-c", "import Cython; print('CYTHON VISIBLE', Cython.__version__)"], env=env)
                  print("CYTHON IN BUILD ENV", r)
                  if r != 0:
                      raise RuntimeError("Cython not visible to pygame setup.py")
                  hostpython = sh.Command(host)
                  with current_directory(self.get_build_dir(arch.arch)):
                      print("BUILD_EXT pygame start")
                      shprint(hostpython, "setup.py", "build_ext", "-v", _env=env)
                      libs = glob.glob("build/lib.*")
                      print("BUILD LIBS pygame", libs)
                      if not libs:
                          raise RuntimeError("pygame build_ext produced no lib")
              def install_python_package(self, arch, name=None, env=None, is_dir=True):
                  dest = self.ctx.get_python_install_dir(arch.arch)
                  with current_directory(self.get_build_dir(arch.arch)):
                      libs = glob.glob("build/lib.*")
                      print("PYGAME LIBS", libs)
                      if not libs:
                          raise RuntimeError("pygame build/lib missing")
                      src = join(libs[0], "pygame")
                      dst = join(dest, "pygame")
                      if os.path.isdir(dst):
                          shutil.rmtree(dst)
                      shutil.copytree(src, dst)
                      print("COPIED pygame to", dst)
              def get_recipe_env(self, arch):
                  env = super().get_recipe_env(arch)
                  env["USE_SDL2"] = "1"
                  env["PYGAME_CROSS_COMPILE"] = "TRUE"
                  env["PYGAME_ANDROID"] = "TRUE"
                  env["PIP_USE_PEP517"] = "0"
                  env["SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS"] = "stdlib"
                  env["_PYTHON_HOST_PLATFORM"] = "linux-aarch64"
                  env["ARCHFLAGS"] = ""
                  extra = getattr(self, "_extra_cflags", "")
                  if extra:
                      env["CFLAGS"] = env.get("CFLAGS", "") + " " + extra
                      env["CPPFLAGS"] = env.get("CPPFLAGS", "") + " " + extra
                  sites = getattr(self, "_cython_sites", None)
                  if sites:
                      env["PYTHONPATH"] = ":".join(sites) + ":" + env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
                  return env
          recipe = PygameCeRecipe()
          ''').lstrip())
          compile(Path("app/p4a-recipes/pygame-ce/__init__.py").read_text(), "pygame-ce", "exec")
          print("recipes syntax OK")
          ENDPY

      - name: Patch buildozer.spec
        run: |
          python3 << 'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          p = Path("app/buildozer.spec")
          t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
          def set_opt(text, key, val):
              pat = rf'(?m)^[ \t]*#?[ \t]*{re.escape(key)}[ \t]*=.*$'
              line = f"{key} = {val}"
              if re.search(pat, text):
                  return re.sub(pat, line, text)
              return re.sub(r'(?m)^\[app\][ \t]*$', "[app]\n" + line, text, count=1)
          t = set_opt(t, "version", "0.7.2.1")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.accept_sdk_license", "True")
          t = set_opt(t, "p4a.branch", "master")
          t = set_opt(t, "p4a.local_recipes", "./p4a-recipes")
          t = set_opt(t, "p4a.setup_py", "False")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.ndk", "25b")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.api", "34")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.minapi", "24")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.ndk_api", "24")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.archs", "arm64-v8a")
          t = set_opt(t, "source.filename", "main.py")
          t = set_opt(t, "requirements", "python3==3.11.10,hostpython3==3.11.10,pygame-ce,sdl2,sdl2_image,sdl2_mixer,sdl2_ttf,png,jpeg")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.permissions", "WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE,READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE")
          t = set_opt(t, "android.wakelock", "True")
          t = re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*#?[ \t]*source\.include_exts[ \t]*=.*$', "#source.include_exts =", t)
          t = re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*#?[ \t]*android\.extra_manifest_application_arguments[ \t]*=.*$', "#android.extra_manifest_application_arguments =", t)
          p.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
          for fn in ("setup.py", "pyproject.toml", "extra_manifest.txt", "_game_main.py"):
              fp = Path("app") / fn
              if fp.exists():
                  fp.unlink()
          main = Path("app/main.py")
          orig = main.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
          hook = (
              "import os, sys, traceback\n"
              "def _log(msg):\n"
              "    homes = []\n"
              "    for k in ('ANDROID_PRIVATE', 'ANDROID_ARGUMENT'):\n"
              "        v = os.environ.get(k)\n"
              "        if v:\n"
              "            homes.append(v)\n"
              "    homes.append(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))\n"
              "    homes.append('/sdcard/Download')\n"
              "    homes.append('/storage/emulated/0/Download')\n"
              "    for h in homes:\n"
              "        try:\n"
              "            os.makedirs(h, exist_ok=True)\n"
              "            with open(os.path.join(h, 'imprison-crash.txt'), 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n"
              "                f.write(msg + chr(10))\n"
              "        except Exception:\n"
              "            pass\n"
              "_log('boot ' + sys.version)\n"
              "_log('cwd=' + os.getcwd())\n"
              "try:\n"
              "    _log('ls=' + ','.join(sorted(os.listdir('.'))[:40]))\n"
              "except Exception as e:\n"
              "    _log('ls fail ' + repr(e))\n"
              "def _hook(t, v, tb):\n"
              "    _log(''.join(traceback.format_exception(t, v, tb)))\n"
              "    sys.__excepthook__(t, v, tb)\n"
              "sys.excepthook = _hook\n"
          )
          if "sys.excepthook = _hook" not in orig:
              lines = orig.splitlines(keepends=True)
              i = 0
              if lines and lines[0].startswith("#!"):
                  i = 1
              if i < len(lines) and re.search(r"coding[:=]", lines[i]):
                  i += 1
              while i < len(lines) and lines[i].lstrip().startswith("from __future__ import"):
                  i += 1
              main.write_text("".join(lines[:i]) + hook + "".join(lines[i:]), encoding="utf-8")
              print("PREPENDED crash hook into main.py")
          PY
          test -f app/main.py
          test ! -f app/_game_main.py

      - name: Build APK
        run: |
          set +e
          cd app
          test -f main.py
          test ! -f setup.py
          test ! -f _game_main.py
          buildozer -v android debug > ../out.txt 2>&1
          code=$?
          mkdir -p ../art
          cp ../out.txt ../art/build.log
          find . -name "*.apk" -exec cp {} ../art/ \;
          cd ..
          python3 extract.py
          ls -lah art
          exit $code

      - name: Upload artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: build-out
          path: art
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Upload APK to Release
        if: success()
        run: |
          set -e
          ls -lah art
          gh release upload "$TAG" art/*.apk --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
